reviews.body: Thank you. This is the right shape: a flow file that is there and cannot be read is its own blocking category with the parse error, it is never counted as deleted, and the gate fails closed even when no readable flow is touched, so a CLI too old to read the suite can never pass. Naming `reticle update` for a newer format is a good touch. The docs table and the hook line are updated too. This merges when CI passes.

[Approve preview](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/pull/2518/checks?check_run_id=139924067952)

Thanks for your first pull request to Reticle! A maintainer aims to review within two days. Before then, `pnpm verify` locally catches most of what CI will, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains the rest. If CI does not start, a maintainer needs to approve it for first-time contributors; that is normal.
